title: Multi-candidate feedback lacked attribution and replay trusted its own StateCard

evidence.locator: candidate_selected and the turn-2 provider reference bundle StateCard
evidence.scope: Explicit CPU doubles. Metadata above is the original fixture declaration, not hardware, provider, custody or Compiler release qualification.

observation: The retained two-turn fixture selected the second candidate among three submissions and two searches. Next-turn numeric/profile feedback did not identify that candidate or expose the other evaluated result. Semantic replay accepted this omission because the bundle was checked against its own StateCard.
proposed_change: Project bounded per-candidate feedback with existing identity and source Turn, preserving evaluated, rejected, duplicate and unsearched states. Reconstruct next-turn and terminal feedback from prior action, filter, rejection and Receipt facts. Keep selection, budget, confirmation and reference permissions unchanged.
verification_status: Software implementation and focused positive/negative CPU contracts pass; broader regression results are recorded in the external implementation report. Review and platform integration remain pending.
disposition: Proposed Lab protocol successor. No new Compiler primitive, release, provider qualification, device performance result or author-learning claim. Historical Runs and their original classifications remain unchanged.
